name: Meridian Rose Gold Wristwatch
description: A hand-finished rose gold timepiece with a hand-guilloché dial and sapphire crystal.
story: Inspired by the golden hour over the Amalfi coast, each dial is engraved by a single artisan over three days.
symbolicMeaning: Time given with intention — a reminder that the best moments deserve to be marked.

name: Atelier Cashmere Wrap
description: An oversized cashmere wrap woven in a family-run Scottish mill, finished with hand-rolled edges.
story: Woven from the softest first-clip cashmere, the kind reserved for a maison's private clients.
symbolicMeaning: Warmth, literal and otherwise — something to wrap around someone you want to protect.

name: Lumen Hand-Blown Decanter
description: A sculptural hand-blown crystal decanter, each piece unique in its imperfections.
story: Blown in a single breath by a third-generation glassmaker in the Vosges.
symbolicMeaning: A vessel for gathering — for the nights that deserve to be poured slowly.

name: Encre Fountain Pen, Burgundy Resin
description: An 18k gold nib fountain pen cast in deep burgundy resin with a hand-polished barrel.
story: Each nib is tuned by hand to the individual writer's grip before it ships.
symbolicMeaning: For the words that matter enough to be written slowly.

name: Nocturne Silk Eye Mask & Robe Set
description: Mulberry silk sleep set in a private-label charcoal and cream colorway.
story: Designed for the traveler who never quite unpacks — a small ritual of rest anywhere.
symbolicMeaning: Permission to rest, wrapped in something beautiful.

name: Ember Leather Travel Journal
description: Full-grain leather journal with hand-stitched binding and a brass travel clasp.
story: Designed alongside a cartographer, with a fold-out map sleeve for the pages between destinations.
symbolicMeaning: For the stories not yet written — a nudge to go make them.

name: Solstice Diamond Pendant
description: A single brilliant-cut diamond suspended on an 18k gold chain, designed to catch light with movement.
story: Named for the two days a year when light is most deliberate — a piece meant to be worn, not saved.
symbolicMeaning: A quiet, permanent way of saying 'I see you.'

name: Terroir Reserve Wine Trio
description: Three limited-production reds from a single Burgundy vineyard, presented in a cedar case.
story: Sourced directly from a fourth-generation winemaker who releases fewer than 800 cases a year.
symbolicMeaning: A toast to whatever's being celebrated — and a reason to slow down together.

name: Argent Cufflinks, Hand-Engraved
description: Sterling silver cufflinks with a hand-engraved monogram, boxed in walnut.
story: Engraved to order by a single engraver who has worked with the maison for over twenty years.
symbolicMeaning: A small, permanent detail only the wearer knows the story behind.

name: Velours Weekender Bag
description: Full-grain Italian leather weekender with brass hardware and a lifetime repair guarantee.
story: Built on the same pattern the house has used since 1961, aged to a deep patina with use.
symbolicMeaning: For the trips taken on impulse — packed light, meant well.

name: Ambre Nuit Fragrance
description: A warm amber and smoked vanilla eau de parfum, hand-blended in small batches.
story: Composed by a perfumer who spent a decade in Grasse before founding the house.
symbolicMeaning: A scent memory in the making — something to be remembered by.

name: Heirloom Backgammon Set
description: Walnut and leather backgammon set with hand-turned bone pieces.
story: Modeled on a 19th-century set found in a Marrakech antiques market.
symbolicMeaning: An invitation to sit down together, unhurried, for an evening.

name: Porcelaine Tea Ceremony Set
description: Hand-painted porcelain tea set for two, glazed in soft gold and cream.
story: Each piece painted freehand by a single ceramicist, no two sets identical.
symbolicMeaning: A small daily ritual, made a little more beautiful.

name: Obsidian Chess Set
description: Hand-carved obsidian and alabaster chess set on a marble board.
story: Carved from volcanic stone sourced in the same region for three generations.
symbolicMeaning: A quiet challenge, beautifully made — for the strategist in your life.

name: Cachemire Baby Blanket
description: Featherweight cashmere blanket, hand-finished with a satin edge, monogram optional.
story: Woven at the same mill that has outfitted the house's baby line since 1958.
symbolicMeaning: A soft beginning to a new chapter in someone's family.

name: Atlas Star Map, Custom Coordinates
description: A framed engraving of the night sky as it appeared over a chosen place and date.
story: Astronomically accurate, hand-plotted, and framed in reclaimed oak.
symbolicMeaning: A moment in time, fixed permanently in the sky above it.

name: Noir Leather Desk Set
description: Hand-stitched black leather desk set: blotter, pen tray, and notebook cover.
story: Made by the same atelier that outfits several European ministries.
symbolicMeaning: For the desk where important decisions get made.

name: Golden Hour Photography Print Series
description: A framed triptych from a limited-edition landscape series, archival pigment print.
story: Shot over a single golden hour on the Cornish coast, printed in an edition of 50.
symbolicMeaning: For someone who finds meaning in stillness and light.

name: Reverie Music Box, Hand-Wound
description: A Swiss-made music box with a hand-selected melody, housed in a walnut and brass case.
story: Built on movements from a workshop that has made music boxes since 1886.
symbolicMeaning: A small, wind-up piece of memory you can return to any time.

name: Sable Hair Art Brush Set
description: A hand-bound set of fine sable brushes in a rolled canvas case.
story: Sourced from the same supplier used by several national academies of fine art.
symbolicMeaning: An invitation to keep making things.

name: Champagne Sabre, Engraved
description: A ceremonial champagne sabre with an engraved blade, boxed in velvet.
story: Modeled on the cavalry tradition of sabrage, reborn as a celebratory ritual.
symbolicMeaning: For the toasts worth making a small production of.

name: Terra Ceramic Vase Trio
description: Three hand-thrown stoneware vases in a graduated warm palette.
story: Thrown on a single wheel by a ceramicist working from a coastal studio.
symbolicMeaning: Simple beauty for a home just starting to become someone's own.

name: Aurora Pearl Drop Earrings
description: South Sea pearl drop earrings set in 18k white gold.
story: Each pearl hand-matched for luster from a single harvest.
symbolicMeaning: A quiet kind of luxury — the sort that ages beautifully.

name: Cartographer's Globe, Antique Brass
description: A hand-painted 12-inch globe on a brass meridian stand.
story: Built by a workshop that restores 19th-century globes for museums.
symbolicMeaning: For someone who's always already planning the next trip.

name: Cocoon Cashmere Throw
description: A generously sized cashmere throw in a heathered charcoal-burgundy weave.
story: Woven from the same undyed cashmere fiber the house has sourced since its founding.
symbolicMeaning: For evenings spent doing absolutely nothing, together.

name: Meridian Whiskey Decanter Set
description: A crystal decanter with four hand-cut tumblers, boxed in a burgundy case.
story: Cut by hand in a workshop known for supplying private members' clubs.
symbolicMeaning: For the ritual of the first pour after a long week.

name: Signet Ring, Hand-Engraved
description: An 18k gold signet ring with a hand-engraved initial or crest.
story: Engraved using the same hand-tool technique the house has used since 1932.
symbolicMeaning: A mark that's entirely theirs, worn every day.

name: Botanical Candle Trio
description: Three hand-poured soy candles in botanical scents, housed in ceramic vessels.
story: Poured in small batches, the vessels reusable as planters once the candle is spent.
symbolicMeaning: A small warmth for a home, and a little more once the candle's gone.

name: Grand Tour Leather Passport Set
description: A passport holder and luggage tag set in full-grain leather, monogrammed.
story: Designed for the traveler who treats every departure like an occasion.
symbolicMeaning: A small vote of confidence in wherever they're headed next.

name: Heritage Wool Throw Pillow Pair
description: A pair of heavyweight wool pillows in a herringbone burgundy weave.
story: Woven on vintage looms restored specifically for this collection.
symbolicMeaning: Small, easy comfort for a space someone's making their own.

name: Atelier Sketchbook & Graphite Set
description: A hand-bound sketchbook with a roll of graphite pencils in graded hardness.
story: Bound using the same paper stock preferred by several working illustrators.
symbolicMeaning: Room to keep making things, one page at a time.

name: Vintage-Inspired Compass, Brass
description: A working brass compass with an engraved inner lid, boxed in walnut.
story: Modeled after 1920s expedition compasses, rebuilt with a modern precision movement.
symbolicMeaning: For someone who's always finding their own direction.

name: Silk Bow Tie & Pocket Square Set
description: Hand-rolled silk bow tie and pocket square in a matching burgundy weave.
story: Cut from the same bolt of silk to ensure a perfect match, finished by hand.
symbolicMeaning: A small, sharp detail for a day that calls for one.

name: Midnight Library Book Set
description: A curated set of three clothbound classics, rebound in the house's signature burgundy cloth.
story: Rebound by hand from first editions sourced from a London bindery.
symbolicMeaning: For someone who's always got a book going — and always wants another.

name: Hand-Forged Garden Tool Set
description: A three-piece garden tool set forged from carbon steel with ash handles.
story: Forged by a smith who has supplied several royal garden estates.
symbolicMeaning: For someone who finds peace with their hands in the soil.
